summary.en: Tic-tac-toe with one rule changed — a 4×4 board, two marks a turn — playable solo, against an AI, or online with a second phone.
summary.jp: ○×を一部変え、4×4・1手2個置き。1台でもAI相手でも、2台でも遊べる。

mine: Co-invented the 4×4, two-marks-per-turn rule with his son over hundreds of rounds on paper and notes apps
Built one board that works face-to-face, against an AI opponent, and online
Built the Gemini-first AI opponent with a local-search fallback across 4 difficulty levels
Wrote the QR/code pairing, presence, and rejoin logic that became the starting point for the separate Snap Pair library
